capabilities: Toggle the selected link between wikilink and Markdown format
Convert links via a command palette command or hotkey
extras: Bulk conversion of all links in selected text is listed only as a future plan, not implemented. Version history notes a hotkey change due to a conflict.
problem: Obsidian lets notes use either wikilinks or Markdown links, but offers no built-in command to convert a single link from one format to the other.
summary: Link format converter that toggles a single selected link between wikilink and Markdown link syntax via a command or hotkey.
